comment: What a hosted connector's caller proxy answers when it refuses a caller (ADR-0168 decision 7), and what the runner reads back to name the refusal. The proxy (apps/worker/src/curie_connector_proxy/server.py) answers every refusal with `status` and a JSON-RPC error body, never contacts the connector, and sends no WWW-Authenticate: a 401 sends the bundled Claude CLI into OAuth discovery and client registration against the connector, and a 403 does not. The MCP client surfaces a JSON-RPC error body at a non-2xx status as the request's error, so the runner (runner/src/curie_runner/mcp_tool_capability.py) finds `error.data.curie_caller` and reports the refusal by name. `header` is the request header the token travels in. `principal_refusals` (ADR 0270 decision 2) are signed cct tokens that carry or attempt a requester principal, each with `name`, `why`, `token` and the `refusal` the proxy answers it with; a principal never changes a refusal's body, so the body is the `vectors` entry for that refusal. They are signed under the first seed in tests/vectors/connector-caller-token.json, the key the proxy's tests configure. Read by apps/worker/tests/test_connector_proxy.py (each token answers its refusal's body) and runner/tests/test_mcp_tool_capability_caller.py (each refusal's body is reported by name), which reject an unknown key so a key added for one reader cannot pass vacuously.

unpaired.why: A signed token that carries run without work_item is malformed and refused as invalid.

error.message: caller refused: no caller token was presented
caller refused: the caller token is not valid
caller refused: the caller token has expired
caller refused: this agent is not admitted by the connector
caller refused: the connector tool call has no matching grant

principal_refusals.name: a_malformed_principal_is_invalid
principal_refusals.why: A signed token whose principal carries a duplicate subject key is malformed and refused as invalid, the same body as any malformed token.

principal_refusals.name: a_requester_on_an_agent_the_connector_does_not_admit
principal_refusals.why: A well-formed principal adds no admission: agent admission is judged first, and a requester cannot carry an agent past it.

principal_refusals.name: an_expired_token_with_a_requester
principal_refusals.why: A principal-bearing token past its exp is expired like any other.
